figures.name: leaves_parts_rebuilt
figures.basis: predicted: the metrics rebuild with --metrics-label-index gives at least one part of a tenant holding metrics its label_value leaves

figures.name: leaves_parts_deferred
figures.basis: predicted: the rebuild covers every part of a quiescent ci tenant in one run

figures.name: leaves_parts_erasure_gated
figures.basis: predicted: nothing is erased on a fresh ci tenant

figures.name: leaves_parts_over_cap
figures.basis: predicted: no ci part holds more entries than the rebuild's per-part cap

figures.name: leaves_uncovered_entries
figures.basis: predicted: every entry of a rebuilt ci part is covered by its leaves

figures.name: unrouted_label_value_leaf_parts
figures.basis: predicted: no fold before stage1-leaves runs with --fold-metrics-label-index, so the unrouted pass reads a snapshot without label_value leaves (run.sh refuses the pass otherwise)

figures.name: routed_label_value_leaf_parts
figures.basis: predicted: the routed pass reads the snapshot stage1-leaves published, with at least one part carrying a label_value leaf

figures.name: entries_compared
figures.basis: predicted: both steady passes return a result_hash for at least one corpus entry

figures.name: entries_differing
figures.basis: predicted: routing prunes objects, never results, so every entry's unrouted and routed hashes are equal

figures.name: entries_without_hash
figures.basis: predicted: every corpus entry answers (ok or incorrect, both carrying a result_hash) in both passes on ci

figures.name: statements_status_differing
figures.basis: predicted (ADR-3694 row 9): routing changes which objects are opened, never the oracle's verdict, so each entry's set of record statuses is the same in the unrouted and routed passes; an entry known to be incorrect stays incorrect in both

figures.name: unrouted_records_status_unexpected
figures.basis: predicted (ADR-3694 row 9): every unrouted record's status is ok or incorrect on ci; partial, timeout, error, unsupported_construct, refused or a failure string counts here

figures.name: routed_records_status_unexpected
figures.basis: predicted (ADR-3694 row 9): every routed record's status is ok or incorrect on ci; partial, timeout, error, unsupported_construct, refused or a failure string counts here

figures.name: unrouted_records_answered_null_hash
figures.basis: predicted: every unrouted record whose status is ok or incorrect carries a result_hash (records with another status are counted by records_status_unexpected instead)

figures.name: routed_records_answered_null_hash
figures.basis: predicted: every routed record whose status is ok or incorrect carries a result_hash (records with another status are counted by records_status_unexpected instead)

figures.name: unrouted_records_label_index_null
figures.basis: predicted: every unrouted record carries a segmentsPrunedByLabelIndex figure

figures.name: routed_records_label_index_null
figures.basis: predicted: every routed record carries a segmentsPrunedByLabelIndex figure

figures.name: unrouted_records_pruned_by_label_index
figures.basis: predicted: with no label_value leaf in the snapshot, no unrouted record prunes an object through the label index

figures.name: routed_records_pruned_by_label_index
figures.basis: predicted: at least one routed positive-equality statement skips an object through a label_value leaf

figures.name: unrouted_cold_records
figures.basis: predicted: no corpus entry of class long_range or mb_full_range_avg_over_time is declared for ci, so stage1.unrouted_cold says not applicable and its count is 0 of 0; on a profile that selects cold entries the band is at least entries x 5 repetitions, and a cold stamp that failed or is absent leaves no count, which fails as missing

figures.name: unrouted_cold_records_short
figures.basis: predicted: every selected cold entry x repetition has a record with a ravel_cost (0 selected on ci)

figures.name: routed_cold_records
figures.basis: predicted: no corpus entry of class long_range or mb_full_range_avg_over_time is declared for ci, so stage1.routed_cold says not applicable and its count is 0 of 0; on a profile that selects cold entries the band is at least entries x 5 repetitions, and a cold stamp that failed or is absent leaves no count, which fails as missing

figures.name: routed_cold_records_short
figures.basis: predicted: every selected cold entry x repetition has a record with a ravel_cost (0 selected on ci)

figures.name: holders_objects_above_watermark
figures.basis: predicted: the fold step ran with --writers-stopped after the last write, so every listed object's ingest hour is at or below the folded watermark

figures.name: holders_window_mismatches
figures.basis: predicted: every unrouted record's segmentsFetched equals its statement's unrouted_fetched_expected: named_in_window (the objects in the window holding a series of the statement's one metric, since the unrouted resolve prunes by that name's postings) when every selector names one metric, segments_in_window (every object in the window) when they name different metrics

figures.name: holders_window_unchecked
figures.basis: predicted: every counted statement has unrouted records, each with a whole-number segmentsFetched, and a whole-number unrouted_fetched_expected

figures.name: holders_selective_job_rate_sum
figures.basis: predicted: job="metricsbench-api" series are written on every ci run, so at least one data object holds one (the statement is route-bound: its one selector carries that matcher)
